display.purpose: Spaced-caps wordmark and flapping board titles; amber, always ready to turn a cell.

body.purpose: Departure rows, metadata, prompts; uppercase on the board, sentence case in the simple TUI.

label.purpose: Board headers, stamps, and key chips; uppercase, dim or amber.

motion.purpose: Letters cycle then settle left-to-right when a departure updates or the board wakes.

motion.name: stamp-blink
motion.purpose: NOW DEPARTING / VISUALS OFF pulses calmly; the only blink in the world.

motion.name: clock-tick
motion.purpose: The live clock in the board header and the search line.

motion.name: board-scan
motion.purpose: A single dot travels the title rule; the board refreshes, never a false duration.

narrative.overview:
A single departure board in a near-empty station at night. Every track is a departure; the queue is the timetable; the radio is a station that keeps routing you onward; a finished session is the last train gone. MusicCLI is that board: you arrive, you tell the agent where you are headed, the board seeks connections, and when the board is showing you a departure that is the song now playing.

The world is deliberately terminal-native: one fixed-width character grid is the only geometry, depth is drawn with dimming rather than glyph density, and every animation is a pure function of a session snapshot plus its own clock. The previous arcade-cabinet look was refused because a midnight depot needs one quiet board, not a carnival.

State is honest signage: NOW DEPARTING while a track plays, VISUALS OFF when the board is powered down, LAST TRAIN DEPARTED when nothing is queued. One amber live column; dim ink everywhere else. Color never competes.
